last.verdict: DraftKings cut 2026 profit guidance to $175-275 million from $700-900 million, as spending on its new Predictions product swamped a healthy core business.

takeaways.label: Profit outlook slashed
takeaways.text: 2026 adjusted EBITDA (operating profit before some costs) guidance fell to $175-275 million from $700-900 million. Revenue guidance was lowered to $6.35-6.55 billion from $6.5-6.9 billion.

takeaways.label: Predictions spending
takeaways.text: Predictions (prediction markets) will absorb $650-700 million of 2026 profit, with 1.6 million customers so far. Promotions to win new users leave 2026 Predictions revenue immaterial.

takeaways.label: Core business still earns
takeaways.text: Excluding Predictions, 2026 adjusted EBITDA is guided to $875-925 million. Q3 revenue rose 16% to $1.33 billion, and monthly paying users rose 13% to 4.1 million.

takeaways.label: 2027 is the payoff bet
takeaways.text: 2027 guidance: revenue $7.35-7.75 billion and adjusted EBITDA $800 million-$1 billion, including $650-750 million of Predictions revenue and about $300 million of investment in it.

history.verdict: Investors looked past a revenue miss to strong user growth and unchanged full-year profit targets.

reasons.label: Surging customer growth
reasons.text: Monthly paying users rose 9% to 3.6 million, about 16% above expectations.

reasons.label: Guidance held
reasons.text: Full-year profit outlook stayed at $700-900 million; core business should earn about $1 billion.

reasons.label: Prediction markets momentum
reasons.text: New Predictions product has over 600,000 users and is growing faster than management expected.
